# Cos

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Cos:Float32 degrees:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `degrees` | In | Float32 | required | The angle in degrees. |

**Returns:** A value from -1 to 1.

## Description

Returns the cosine of an angle given in degrees, not radians.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Cos(60)
```

```text
0.5
```
